name: Servers
overview: Scripture reveals that serving the Lord is a wholehearted commitment, requiring love, obedience, and exclusive devotion, as emphasized in Joshua's call to serve God with all heart and soul and the choice to serve Him over other gods. Jesus teaches that no one can serve two masters, highlighting the necessity of undivided loyalty to God rather than material wealth. True greatness in God's kingdom is marked by humble service to others, exemplified by Christ Himself, who came to minister and give His life for many. Serving others, including the poor, is also portrayed as serving the Lord, promising divine recompense for acts of mercy.
